grammar.pattern: 离 + 地点 / 时间 + 距离
grammar.purpose: State distance relative to a reference point
grammar.explanation: 入口离湖一公里 names the entrance as the subject and lake as the reference. 地图上直线距离 and actual walking distance can differ; use the label given. 离星期六还有两天 similarly measures remaining time. 不远 is an evaluation and does not supply an exact number.

examples.py: rù kǒu lí hú yī gōng lǐ .
examples.en: The entrance is one kilometre from the lake.

examples.py: chāo shì lí rù kǒu wǔ bǎi mǐ .
examples.en: The supermarket is five hundred metres from the entrance.

examples.py: lí xīng qī liù hái yǒu liǎng tiān .
examples.en: There are still two days until Saturday.

commonMistakes.why: Put the reference place after 离, then the distance.

grammar.purpose: Express a measured difference or extent
grammar.explanation: 北边的路比南边的路长两百米 states a measured difference, not the total length. This note gives south route one kilometre and north route one point two kilometres, so the difference is two hundred metres. A road two metres wider describes width, not distance from a place. Keep the unit and comparison explicit.

examples.zh: 北边的路比南边的路长两百米。
examples.py: běi biān de lù bǐ nán biān de lù zhǎng liǎng bǎi mǐ .
examples.en: The north route is two hundred metres longer than the south route.

examples.py: zhè miàn qiáng gāo liǎng mǐ .
examples.en: This wall is two metres high.

examples.zh: 入口离湖一公里，不是两百米。
examples.py: rù kǒu lí hú yī gōng lǐ , bù shì liǎng bǎi mǐ .
examples.en: The entrance is one kilometre from the lake, not two hundred metres.

commonMistakes.wrong: 北边的路长两百米，所以一共两百米。
commonMistakes.right: 北边的路比南边的路长两百米，一共一千二百米。
commonMistakes.why: A comparative difference is not the total length.

dialogue.title: A shorter walk
dialogue.blurb: Original AI-assisted course writing; not adapted from a show or song.
dialogue.purpose: Read the distances, then choose the agreed route.

lines.zh: 去海边还是湖边？
lines.py: qù hǎi biān hái shi hú biān ?
lines.en: The seaside or the lakeside?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 海边太远，今天在公园走走吧。
lines.py: hǎi biān tài yuǎn , jīn tiān zài gōng yuán zǒu zǒu ba .
lines.en: The seaside is too far; let us walk in the park today.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 入口离湖多远？
lines.py: rù kǒu lí hú duō yuǎn ?
lines.en: How far is the entrance from the lake?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 南边的路一公里，北边一千二百米。
lines.py: nán biān de lù yī gōng lǐ , běi biān yī qiān èr bǎi mǐ .
lines.en: The south route is one kilometre; the north route is twelve hundred metres.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 北边长两百米，不是只有两百米。
lines.py: běi biān zhǎng liǎng bǎi mǐ , bù shì zhǐ yǒu liǎng bǎi mǐ .
lines.en: The north route is two hundred metres longer, not only two hundred metres in total.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 对。我的脚累了，选南边吧。
lines.py: duì . wǒ de jiǎo lèi le , xuǎn nán biān ba .
lines.en: Right. My feet are tired; let us choose south.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 超市离入口五百米，要不要先去？
lines.py: chāo shì lí rù kǒu wǔ bǎi mǐ , yào bù yào xiān qù ?
lines.en: The supermarket is five hundred metres from the entrance; shall we go first?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 今天不用，先到湖边坐一会儿。
lines.py: jīn tiān bù yòng , xiān dào hú biān zuò yī huì er .
lines.en: No need today; first go to the lakeside and sit a while.
lines.speaker: b

choices: It is shorter and the speaker’s feet are tired

lines.py: dì tú shàng fāng shì běi , xià fāng shì nán .

lines.zh: 入口到湖的南路一公里，北路一千二百米。
lines.py: rù kǒu dào hú de nán lù yī gōng lǐ , běi lù yī qiān èr bǎi mǐ .

lines.zh: 北路比南路长两百米。
lines.py: běi lù bǐ nán lù zhǎng liǎng bǎi mǐ .

lines.zh: 超市在入口南边，离入口五百米。
lines.py: chāo shì zài rù kǒu nán biān , lí rù kǒu wǔ bǎi mǐ .
lines.en: The supermarket is south of the entrance, five hundred metres from it.

lines.zh: 草地旁边有墙，墙边的路可以走，不用爬。
lines.py: cǎo dì páng biān yǒu qiáng , qiáng biān de lù kě yǐ zǒu , bù yòng pá .
lines.en: There is a wall beside the lawn; the path by the wall is usable and requires no climbing.

lines.zh: 门上写拉，别推。瓶子倒下了，要放好。
lines.py: mén shàng xiě lā , bié tuī . píng zi dǎo xià le , yào fàng hǎo .
lines.en: The door says pull; do not push. A bottle has fallen over and should be put properly in place.

lines.zh: 我们先到湖边休息，看鸟，不给动物吃东西。
lines.py: wǒ men xiān dào hú biān xiū xī , kàn niǎo , bù gěi dòng wù chī dōng xi .
lines.en: We first rest by the lake, watch birds, and do not feed the animals.

notes: AI-assisted draft; native review pending. GF2021 grammar families: 二27, 二53. Native check: distance versus route length, quantity complements, 背 bèi verb recite versus bēi carry and 倒 dǎo versus dào. Body-part 背 ownership remains later. The north-up map and distances are fictional but explicit; no outdoor route recommendation or diagnosis. Planned retrieval 二21 / 二40: 今天我当组长，明天换人。, 我们想办活动，还没有举行。, 目的是让大家练习说汉语。.
